name: The conquest of the Sokoto Caliphate

summary.text: Frederick Lugard’s West African Frontier Force marched north from Zungeru and Zaria, took Kano in February 1903 and defeated the Caliph’s army outside Sokoto in March. Caliph Attahiru I led a hijra of thousands eastward and was killed at Burmi in July; many of his followers went on to the Sudan.

moments.title: Kano taken

moments.title: Sokoto

moments.title: Burmi
